description: This source file implements the logic for handling EGO (Exhaust Gas Oxygen) sensors in a fuel management system, including initialization, averaging filters, and sensor data acquisition, supporting various EGO sensor types and configurations.

classes.name: cyclic_buffer<float, EGO_AVG_BUF_SIZE>
classes.description: A circular buffer used for storing EGO AFR values for averaging purposes.

methods.name: initEgoAveraging
methods.description: Initializes the EGO averaging subsystem, enabling it for Narrow Band sensors if configured.

methods.name: updateEgoAverage
methods.description: Updates the moving average of AFR values using a CIC filter, adjusting for sensor noise and response times.

methods.name: hasAfrSensor
methods.description: Detects if an AFR sensor is present and enabled, supporting different sensor types.

methods.name: getAfr
methods.description: Reads the current AFR value from the sensor, supporting narrow-band and other sensor types, with optional averaging.

methods.name: initEgoSensor
methods.description: Initializes an AFR sensor structure with calibration parameters based on sensor type.

methods.name: setEgoSensor
methods.description: Configures the AFR sensor type for the current engine configuration and initializes it.

calls: interpolateMsg("AFR", sensor->v1, sensor->value1, sensor->v2, sensor->value2, volts)
